ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels concentrated in the central regions, and 35% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels concentrated in the distal lobe areas.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black pigmentation field occupying the central 2/3 of the fluke. Distal regions (left and right tips) display complex, high-density black mottling and irregular focal spots on a white base. Extreme lateral edges show high-contrast contiguous black banding.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration along the entire trailing edge of both lobes. Features a sequence of sharp peaks and deep valleys. A notable large-scale indentation is present on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge trajectory with a distinct concave sweep on the trailing edge from the distal tips toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized circular, high-contrast white and dark pixel clusters present on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned, thin linear dark-pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible against the white-pigmented distal region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of barnacles/parasitic lesions on the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Multiple vertical and oblique linear scrape marks on the white distal pigmentation of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct dark circular ring-shaped mark located within the white-pigmented region of the left distal lobe tip.
